scalars.scalar_value: Master’s degree, or advanced degree in a relevant discipline required.

A minimum of 3 years of experience in the relevant fields of Title VI, Civil Rights, or Higher Education. Experience in student affairs – including residence life, student support/behavioral intervention, and advising – is strongly preferred.

The regular hours for this part time position are between 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., Monday – Friday. Holiday, weekend and evening work hours will be required. Travel will be required. Regular hours may vary due to needs of the College or division.

items.item_text: A valid driver’s license or equivalent means of reliable transportation to off-site meetings and events is required.
